text:
GENERATE BURST N6-turn-N — Necromancer rest frame, direction N, RE-MINT after the owner's review (Run C-6 P2 pass 3; S = the master). task_id "N6-turn-N".

Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (direction S, facing the camera) — identity, face, eyes, hair, armour materials, buckle, tome, scythe design, colours, proportions, CAMERA ANGLE, SCALE and painted register come ONLY from Image 1. Image 2 is the previous attempt at N: its body turn, near side, and which side the blade / horn / tome land on are CORRECT and must be kept — but it carries identity errors (wrong buckle, wrong materials, extra hands or ornaments, a shallower camera) that you must NOT copy: take only the turn and the sides from Image 2, everything else from Image 1.
Deliver EXACTLY ONE image: the SAME character as Image 1, turned to direction N: a full BACK view — he faces directly AWAY from the camera (his back to the viewer). His RIGHT side is on the SCREEN-RIGHT. The scythe is held two-handed IN FRONT of his body: from behind the haft is HIDDEN by the torso except above his RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT, where the BLADE stands, tip the highest point, and below his LEFT hip on the screen-left, where the butt spike shows. His hands are in front of him and hidden by his body — NEVER hands or arms behind his back. The HORN rises from his LEFT shoulder on the SCREEN-LEFT; the TOME at his left hip is on the screen-left. Long bone-white hair covers the upper back; back of the cuirass, both pauldrons and the split skirt seen from behind; the back of the head only, no face.

The camera is fixed for every direction and is EXACTLY Image 1's camera: an elevated view looking DOWN at about 53° — the top of the head and the tops of the shoulders and pauldrons are seen from above, the feet are foreshortened on the ground plane, the ground is UNDER the figure. NOT eye level, NOT a shallower angle: if Image 1's head and feet were drawn at this angle, so are these. The character turns, the camera does not; his sole-to-crown height is the SAME FRACTION of the canvas as in Image 1. The light is fixed for every direction: a single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT that does NOT rotate with the character; deep cool ambient; readable shadows. NO MIRRORING: this is the character turned, never a flipped image — the scythe stays on his ANATOMICAL RIGHT (blade above his right shoulder), the horn on his ANATOMICAL LEFT shoulder, the tome on his ANATOMICAL LEFT hip, whichever side of the screen those land on for the direction. Same framing and standing height as Image 1 (deliver at your native square size; the conductor re-plates): full body, the FIGURE sole-to-crown about 47 % of the canvas height with the feet at about 94 % of the height, the blade rising above the crown and fully inside the canvas — nothing touches the canvas edge — centred, standing rest pose (weight even, both hands on the haft, the blade up), on a flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas — no shadow, no ground, no text, no checkerboard. Identity, unchanged from Image 1 — these are INVARIANTS read from the approved master, check each: a tall gaunt NECROMANCER; long straight bone-white hair to the shoulder blades; chalk-pale skin; PALE ICE-BLUE EYES; HEAD LEVEL WITH THE CHIN FRACTIONALLY RAISED — at this downward camera a level head reads slightly bowed, so hold the chin UP, eyes on the FAR HORIZON in the direction he faces, the face never angled toward the ground, the head aligned with the body (not tilted sideways, not turned against the body); a black cuirass with a POLISHED SILVER-STEEL ribcage relief (metal, the same silver as the trim — NOT bone, NOT ivory) over fine chain; ornate silver-edged pauldrons; ONE great curved bone HORN rising from HIS LEFT shoulder and nothing on the right shoulder; a ROUND PLAIN SILVER BELT DISC with a small leaf-like sigil — NO SKULL on the buckle; a long split skirt of dark panels with silver trim; ridged steel greaves and pointed sabatons; a small dark-leather TOME at HIS LEFT hip with SILVER CORNER CAPS and a short RED RIBBON marker hanging from it — no other emblem on the book; a bone-and-silver WAR SCYTHE held in EXACTLY TWO gauntleted hands (one upper grip near shoulder height, one lower grip near the hip; never a third hand, never a hand emerging from the torso) — straight dark haft with wrapped grips, great ornate crescent blade of pale bone-steel at the top, a short spike at the butt. THERE IS NO SKULL ANYWHERE ON HIM — not on the buckle, not on a shoulder, not on the book. No other objects, no glow, no magic effects, no cape. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line with visible taper, painted fills in clean flat planes inside the line, restrained texture, no gradient haze, no glow, no photographic rendering.

One image_gen call; ONE retry only if the result is off-plate, has a baked checkerboard, is MIRRORED (blade over the wrong shoulder, horn on the wrong shoulder), faces the wrong way, shows a skull anywhere, a third hand, a bone-coloured ribcage, non-blue eyes, a head that reads bowed or looking down AT ALL (this is a hard fail — the still seeds a video and a bowed seed ruins the clip), a sideways-tilted or twisted head, or a shallower camera than Image 1 — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/n6_N.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "N6-turn-N"): files = [out/n6_N.png with sha256]; images = the INTEGER COUNT of image_gen calls (1 or 2); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with concerns listed honestly — state explicitly: eyes colour, buckle, ribcage material, number of hands on the haft, camera angle vs Image 1.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (direction S): identity, materials, buckle, tome, scythe, camera, scale and register to preserve exactly
IMAGE 2 — previous attempt at N: keep ONLY its body turn and item sides; do NOT copy its face, materials, ornaments, hands or camera
